q: Austin's theorem on multiple recurrence for amenable groups and its relation to sofic entropy: the multiple Birkhoff average (1/|Φₙ|) Σ_{g∈Φₙ} T^g f₁ · T^{g²} f₂ converges in L². The connection to sofic entropy is that:
opts: Multiple recurrence requires positive sofic entropy
The non-conventional ergodic averages (Host-Kra theory) use structured extensions that can be viewed as systems of bounded sofic entropy
Sofic entropy is irrelevant to multiple recurrence
exp: Host-Kra theory of characteristic factors for multiple convergence uses nilpotent extensions (nilsystems). These are algebraic actions whose entropy structure (sofic or classical) is well-controlled. The connection is indirect but deep: nilsystems have bounded entropy and control multiple averages.
